tools.name: getUsageConsumption
tools.description: Extracts SuiteScript execution logs to identify scripts that are consuming dangerously high governance usage units and risking limits.

tools.name: getExecutionTimes
tools.description: Calculates execution times (Total Time) across scripts to identify latency and poor system performance.

tools.name: getConcurrencyBottlenecks
tools.description: Identifies concurrency thresholds by looking at overlapping execution windows for Scheduled and RESTlet scripts.
